name: Beast x Light
source:
In order to report the truth, sometimes you need to forget about danger, and sometimes you need to use whatever means possible.
Light is a freelance journalist who holds to that as his principle.
After a certain incident he travels to a country of “therianthropes” ―― to the United States of Colona.
In order to gain more information, he gets closer to the country’s police organisation, the “Public Security Bureau of Investigation,” but everyone he comes across is a formidable therianthrope that he can’t deal with by ordinary means……
“Bring it on! If it’s for the sake of an article, I’ll do whatever I have to.”

Human and therianthrope ―― a unique combination get thrown into a serious crime/suspense drama.

Who can be believed, the humans or the therianthropes?
What is the hidden truth behind this incident?
And what will be Light’s fate when he learns everything?

[from [url=https://beastxlight-translations.tumblr.com/post/154332113707/story]Beast x Light Translations[/url]]
translation:
有时为了报道真相，必须忘记危险，有时还要不择手段。自由记者莱特将这句话奉为原则。

某起事件后，他前往“兽人”国家科洛纳合众国。为了获得更多情报，他接近当地警察组织“公共安全调查局”，但遇到的每一名兽人都极其强大，普通手段根本无法应付……

“放马过来！只要是为了新闻，我什么都做！”

人类与兽人——这对独特组合被卷入严肃的犯罪悬疑剧。

人类与兽人，谁值得相信？

事件背后隐藏的真相是什么？

当莱特得知一切后，他的命运又将如何？

[来源：[url=https://beastxlight-translations.tumblr.com/post/154332113707/story]Beast x Light Translations[/url]]
